title: cyclosorus pennatus
intro: Cyclosorus pennatus, commonly known as the Chinese Tassel Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus pennatus are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an anti-oxidant, and exhibit anti-microbial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
